name: probabl-skills
description: Skills to support Machine Learning experimentation using the Python ecosystem.

skills.title: Explore ML Data
skills.summary: Explore the dataset before designing any model.

skills.title: Frame ML Problem
skills.summary: Lock the problem, deployment setting, metric, baseline, and fold count before any model code.

skills.title: Build ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Declare a skrub DataOps graph from the data source to the predictor after framing is locked.

skills.title: Evaluate ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Evaluate one sklearn-compatible learner with the locked validation scheme and persist structured skore reports.

skills.title: Smoke Test ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Structural pytest: prediction count must match the predict-grid row count.

skills.title: Audit ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Audit a persisted skore report read-only and produce a reusable digest.

skills.title: Manage ML Backlog
skills.summary: Record experiment outcomes and triage idea files into backlog rows, keeping each file with a triage flag.

skills.title: Organize ML Workspace
skills.summary: Deprecated compatibility skill; use setup-workspace.

skills.title: Data Science Python Stack
skills.summary: Deprecated compatibility skill; use choose-python-library and the canonical package policy.

skills.title: Triage ML Task
skills.summary: Session owner: list installed entry skills and ask which to run.

skills.title: Review ML Choices
skills.summary: Show stored project choices and re-enter the skill that can change one.

skills.title: Review ML Experiment
skills.summary: Gate the skore-check audit, then write one idea file per candidate.

skills.title: Shape User Idea
skills.summary: Shape a user idea or a named artifact into one idea file after they confirm.

skills.title: Search ML Literature
skills.summary: Search scientific and technical sources and write one idea file for the direction the user confirms.

skills.title: Set Up ML Project
skills.summary: Coordinate workspace, environment, and git setup.

skills.title: Set Up Git
skills.summary: Initialize safe version control for an ML workspace.

skills.title: Persist ML Git
skills.summary: Commit the current loop stage with the real git CLI when the end-turn hook says invoke.

skills.title: Model ML Pipeline
skills.summary: Require locked problem framing, then coordinate modeling choices, build, smoke testing, evaluation, and audit.

skills.title: Choose Python Library
skills.summary: Resolve a library choice and add the selected dependency.

skills.title: Plot ML Figure
skills.summary: Pick pandas, seaborn, plotly, or matplotlib before writing figure code.

skills.title: Research ML Practice
skills.summary: Literature research for an ML methodology concern.

skills.title: Add Python Package
skills.summary: Add a dependency through the project env manager, or ask the user when the environment is user-managed.

skills.title: Set Up Workspace
skills.summary: Detect or scaffold the standard ML workspace layout.

skills.title: Set Up Python Environment
skills.summary: Detect the env manager and bootstrap the runtime, agent-tools, and composed development environments.

skills.title: Export ML Notebook
skills.summary: Convert a jupytext percent file into an executed notebook.

skills.title: Export ML Site
skills.summary: Package workspace markdown and existing notebook HTML into an offline MkDocs site.

skills.title: Export ML Project
skills.summary: Coordinate executed notebooks and an offline MkDocs documentation site.

skills.title: Sync ML Reports
skills.summary: Copy skore reports between local, Hub, and MLflow, and optionally switch the upload destination.

workflows.title: Set Up an ML Workspace
workflows.summary: Scaffold an ML workspace and configure its environment and git.

workflows.title: Export Notebooks and Site
workflows.summary: Convert percent notebooks and build an offline MkDocs documentation site.

workflows.title: Model an ML Pipeline
workflows.summary: Frame, build, smoke-test with pytest, evaluate, and audit an ML pipeline.

workflows.title: Iterate on ML Experiments
workflows.summary: Triage the loop, build, smoke-test, evaluate, audit reports, and manage the experiment backlog.

workflows.title: ML Experimentation Companion
workflows.summary: A machine learning experiment companion. Focus on the science, the companion organizes the rest with organized workspaces and reporting, auditable results where you are still the owner.
